reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound: MLIPs trained on ab initio data are known to better capture complex liquid configurations than EAM, which directly addresses the phase-space overlap problem, though the specific 20-30% reduction is an estimate.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, comparing free-energy integration paths and phase-space overlap, but the falsification criterion (at least ~20% reduction) is somewhat arbitrary and not derived from a physical threshold.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis directly tackles the core methodological limitation of TOR-TILD for HEAs and proposes a well-defined, modern solution that would be highly valuable for researchers in the field.
